meta.description: Status of the daily data collection. Updated by the GitHub Actions collector on every run. 'Last collected' warnings in the app read this file.

collectors.target: Spotify per-track play totals (third-party public stream figures)
collectors.note: Seeded from the public page dated 2026-10-28. Automation starts with the first scheduled workflow run.

collectors.source: YouTube Data API v3 (channels.list, playlistItems.list, videos.list)
collectors.note: Add YOUTUBE_API_KEY to the repository's Actions secrets to start official collection. Until then, YouTube figures come from dated manual/public observations only.

meta.honestyNote: Days before the first dated observation are never reconstructed. Charts grow as real dated snapshots accumulate.
